base_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Edit the supplied artwork into a polished SQUARE Steam Workshop mod thumbnail. This is an edit target: preserve the original recognizable scene of expressive cartoon ponies arguing with pony tank crews in an old European city street, the tank on the right with red star and flowers, the crowd on the left, the long gun barrel, the vintage documentary painted texture and faded sepia colouring. Do not replace it with a different illustration. Adapt framing into a square using subtle scene extension/reframing if necessary; retain the main faces and confrontation. Improve thumbnail contrast and keep subtle muted red accents on the existing stars and flowers. Add a restrained dark charcoal gradient over the LOWER QUARTER for excellent title contrast. Large, beautifully typeset condensed bold cream/off-white title with subtle deep red shadow, centered across the lower portion: first line exactly "STALLIONGRAD", second line exactly "REWORK", with a smaller exact "(EaW)" centered below. The main title must be extremely readable at small thumbnail size, generous side margins, balanced proportions. Keep title away from the main faces and tank crew; no intrusive border, no extra slogans, no extra logos, no additional emblems or characters. All characters remain original ponies, with hooves and equine anatomy, no humans. Only allowed text is "STALLIONGRAD", "REWORK", "(EaW)". Output square 1024x1024, opaque full-bleed background.
red_revision_prompt: Edit this exact square Steam Workshop thumbnail to be MUCH BRIGHTER and MORE VIVID, with a strong RED colour accent. Preserve the recognizable tank-and-pony confrontation, all characters and faces, flowers, city architecture, composition and exact title typography and text. Move away from the heavily faded sepia look: use a luminous warm golden sky, brighter highlights on faces and steel, clear natural pony colours, olive-green tank surfaces, increased saturation and strong readable contrast. Make the existing tank stars, scarves, red flowers and small fabric accents vivid crimson red. Rework the lower title area into a rich saturated crimson-red to deep burgundy poster-style backdrop blending softly into the scene; keep all title lettering bright warm ivory for maximum legibility. The overall visual should feel like striking illustrated historical poster art, with vivid red as the primary accent, warm gold highlights and dark charcoal depth. Preserve painted photographic grain subtly without muddy darkness. Do not tint the entire image monochrome red: keep distinct natural colours and readable characters. Exact allowed text remains "STALLIONGRAD" on first line, "REWORK" on second, "(EaW)" below. No new text, no new characters, no extra emblems or border. Opaque square 1024x1024.
